_doc: WI-17 criterion 4a. Every training cell (all 2018-2024 races) scored by the exported power-law models in Python (xgboost). powerLaw.test.ts scores the same feature vectors through the ONNX files with onnxruntime-web and must match to 1e-5, on deg20, beta and the tyre curve at `laps`.
